values.value: Discount schedules + rules both modify field

Finds: Quote lines where both a discount schedule and a price rule target the same field (typically discount or NetPrice). Why it matters: Two systems compete for the same field — one overrides the other and the rep can't tell which is active. Discount schedules silently lose to rules or vice versa, creating inconsistent quotes. Suppress a finding: when the layering is intentional (e.g. rules adjust schedule output deliberately). Disable the detector: only when the dual-mechanism is by design. Most should leave this on.
